source: 此兼容版本不读取打包应用启动项。
en: Packaged startup apps are unavailable in this compatibility version.

source: 此兼容版本仅扫描传统桌面软件，不读取打包应用。
en: This compatibility version scans desktop software. Packaged apps are unavailable.

source: 此兼容版本不支持浏览器实时页面预览；可尝试打开已有窗口。
en: Live browser preview is unavailable in this compatibility version. Try opening an existing window.

source: 无法核实关键进程标志，已保守保护此进程。
en: The critical-process flag could not be verified. This process is protected.

source: 32 位兼容模式不能安全重启 AVD 以恢复页面；仍可显示已经存在的图形窗口。
en: 32-bit compatibility mode cannot safely restart an AVD to restore its page. Existing graphical windows can still be shown.
